title: Ding Makiramdam ibat king E Mayayakit
intro: Lampas ning tabing ning mayayakit a yatu, metung a makasalikut a kapulungan ing mitipun king karalumduman, a makaguyud king metung a siwala a sasalangsang king sablang balu ra. Miglakbe la kilub ning dakal a panaun a alang tune tuntunan, angga king ing metung a siwala linabas ya king katahimikan ning karelang e mayayakit a labuad at mekapagmulala king metung a bage king malalam dang pusu. Ngening bengi, agkatan dakayung lumabas karing anino at ibuklat ing pangatau na niting misteryosung grupu, a ing karelang pamakipagtagpo karing banal a amanu migdala karela pabalik karing karelang memalen bilang talapamintu king katutwan a e malyaring pigilan.
clues: Itamu minunang tau, atyu na bayu la pa ding dakal a bangsa a abasa mu, pero bihira tamung sasabyan kareng kwentu da reng tau.
Ing kekaming kalikasan ali ya kalupa mu, megawa ya kareng elementu ning e mayayakit, at atin kaming upaya na lalaban keng ordinaryu.
King kilub ning dakal a panaun, miglakbe kaming alang tune patnube, anggang ing metung a siwala miras kekami a mekapag-stir king metung a bage king malalam a pusu.
dimdam mi ing metung a pamagsalita na ala kaming dimdam, amanung magdalang timbang a lampas keng nanu mang pamagsalita.
linapit kami keng lihim, inutus mi keng sarili mi na manahimik la, at inyang meyari la reng bersikulo, e kami malyaring manatili.
Mibalik kami karing kekaming memalen at sinabi mi: 'O kekaming memalen, dimdam mi ing metung a libru a mibulalag kaybat nang Moises, a magpatutu king minuna kaniti, a manimuna king katutuan.'

identity.label: Ninu Aku?
options: Ding Hawariyyun (Disciples of Isa)
Ing Jinn a meniwala kaybat nang dimdam ing Quran
Ding Kayabe ning Kueba
Ding angeles ning mababang banua
Ding balayan nang Faraon a tinuki king dalan na
identity.answer: Ing Jinn a meniwala kaybat nang dimdam ing Quran

trial.label: Trial / Event
options: Miyugse kami uling e kami bisang sumuku king arap ning bayung melalang a lelangan
Mitatak kami keng metung a kueba kilub ning atlung dalan at siam a banua
Inutus da kekami ing dumalan kami keng dagat a mepitna kekami
Mitubud kami keng gabun ning magic para magaral magic
mekiramdam kami keng metung a pamagbalik keng lihim at mibayu kami uli na niti
trial.answer: mekiramdam kami keng metung a pamagbalik keng lihim at mibayu kami uli na niti

location.label: Key Element
options: Metung a gintung biserung baka a megawa ibat kareng alahas da reng tau
Metung a kueba nung nukarin ing pamangatudtud milabas ya kareng henerasyun
Aduang anghel king Babilonia a tinuru king bawal a beluan
Metung a librung mibulalag kaybat nang Moises, a magpatutu king Torah
Metung a tutung tanaman babo ning banal a bunduk
location.answer: Metung a librung mibulalag kaybat nang Moises, a magpatutu king Torah

outcome.label: Kelabasan
options: Misumpa kami angga king Aldo ning Pamanukum
Tinalakad kami laban king metung a mayupayang pekapun at mitalakad kaming salang king bansa
Mibayu kami keng unggoy ampo babi
Mibalik kami kareng kekaming memalen bilang talapamintu, at pepasiag ing kasalpantayanan
Melumud kami keng dagat kayabe ning kekaming lider
outcome.answer: Mibalik kami kareng kekaming memalen bilang talapamintu, at pepasiag ing kasalpantayanan

arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verse: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. (72:2)
